description: Source code for MemoryProgramCache class managing in-memory storage of compiled shader programs, including hashing, caching, serialization, and cache management functions within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: HashStream
classes.description: Helper class for building hash strings with operator overloading.

methods.name: ComputeHash
methods.description: Computes a SHA1 hash of the program and context properties for caching.

methods.name: getProgram
methods.description: Retrieves a program binary from cache if available and loads it.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Checks if a cached binary exists for a given hash.

methods.name: getAt
methods.description: Retrieves a cached binary at a specific index.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cached entry by hash.

methods.name: putProgram
methods.description: Serializes and stores a program binary into cache.

methods.name: updateProgram
methods.description: Updates cache with current program state.

methods.name: putBinary
methods.description: Stores a binary blob directly into cache.

methods.name: entryCount
methods.description: Returns number of entries in cache.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trims cache to a size limit.
